plan.title: SHG Loan Register Overview
plan.subtitle: Summary of SHG loan register data including repayment status, overdue loans, and purpose of loans

panels.title: Repayment Status Distribution
panels.sql: SELECT "Repayment Status" AS status, COUNT(*) AS count FROM "shg_loan_register" GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: Loan Purpose Distribution
panels.sql: SELECT "Purpose" AS purpose, COUNT(*) AS count FROM "shg_loan_register" GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: Top 10 Loan Purposes by Count
panels.sql: SELECT "Purpose" AS purpose, COUNT(*) AS count FROM "shg_loan_register" GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10

plan.narrative: The total number of loans in the SHG loan register is {{p1}}. The majority of loans are in {{p2.n}} repayment status, indicating a significant portion of loans are either regular or overdue. The most common purpose for loans is {{p3.n}}, which suggests that this is the primary need being addressed through SHG loans. The top 10 purposes by count provide insight into the distribution of loan usage across different sectors, with {{p4.purpose}} being the most frequent purpose.
